Package com.workshop.mcp.spec

Enum Class UniqueKeys

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<UniqueKeys>
com.workshop.mcp.spec.UniqueKeys
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<UniqueKeys>, Constable
public enum UniqueKeys extends Enum<UniqueKeys>
Represents the unique method keys used in the MCP (Model Context Protocol) for JSON-RPC communication.

This enum defines the method names and notification types of protocol revision 2026-07-28. Deletions in that revision are physical: a method absent from the registry must be answered with ErrorCodes.METHOD_NOT_FOUND, even if the server would happily service it. initialize, notifications/initialized, ping, logging/setLevel, notifications/roots/list_changed, resources/subscribe, resources/unsubscribe, tasks/result, and tasks/list are all gone for that reason.

Since:
1.0

  • Enum Constant Details

    • SERVER_DISCOVER

      public static final UniqueKeys SERVER_DISCOVER
      Method for discovering a server's supported protocol revisions, capabilities, and identity.

      Introduced in 2026-07-28 as the sessionless replacement for the initialize handshake. Servers MUST implement it. On stdio a client sends it first as a backward-compatibility probe: an answer means the server speaks the stateless lifecycle, and silence or an error means it should fall back to the legacy handshake.

    • PROMPTS_LIST

      public static final UniqueKeys PROMPTS_LIST
      Method for listing all available prompts. Returns a list of prompt templates that can be used.

    • PROMPTS_GET

      public static final UniqueKeys PROMPTS_GET
      Method for retrieving a specific prompt by name. Returns the expanded prompt with provided arguments.

    • COMPLETION_COMPLETE

      public static final UniqueKeys COMPLETION_COMPLETE
      Method for requesting completion suggestions. Used for auto-completion functionality.

    • NOTIFICATION_CANCELLED

      public static final UniqueKeys NOTIFICATION_CANCELLED
      Notification sent when an operation is cancelled.

      Its requestId is required on this revision. It is also how a client tears down a subscriptions/listen stream, since stdio has no stream to close.

    • TOOLS_LIST

      public static final UniqueKeys TOOLS_LIST
      Method for listing all available tools. Returns the tools that can be invoked by the client.

    • NOT_FOUND

      public static final UniqueKeys NOT_FOUND
      Special key indicating that a method was not found. Used internally for error handling.

    • TOOLS_CALL

      public static final UniqueKeys TOOLS_CALL
      Method for invoking a specific tool. Executes a tool with the provided arguments.

    • RESOURCES_LIST

      public static final UniqueKeys RESOURCES_LIST
      Method for listing available resources. Returns resources that can be accessed by the client.

    • RESOURCES_TEMPLATES_LIST

      public static final UniqueKeys RESOURCES_TEMPLATES_LIST
      Method for listing available resource templates.

      Clients fetch this alongside resources/list whenever the server declares any resource capability, so a server that advertises resources must answer it even when it has no templates.

    • RESOURCES_READ

      public static final UniqueKeys RESOURCES_READ
      Method for reading resource content. Retrieves the actual content of one or more resources.

    • SUBSCRIPTIONS_LISTEN

      public static final UniqueKeys SUBSCRIPTIONS_LISTEN
      Method for opening a long-lived notification stream.

      Introduced in 2026-07-28 to replace the HTTP GET endpoint and the resources/subscribe family. On stdio the request is left unanswered for the life of the subscription; notifications are interleaved on stdout and demultiplexed by MetaKeys.SUBSCRIPTION_ID.

    • NOTIFICATIONS_SUBSCRIPTIONS_ACKNOWLEDGED

      public static final UniqueKeys NOTIFICATIONS_SUBSCRIPTIONS_ACKNOWLEDGED
      Notification reporting which subset of a subscriptions/listen filter the server honored.

      It must carry MetaKeys.SUBSCRIPTION_ID; without it the client waits forever with no error and no timeout.

    • TASKS_GET

      public static final UniqueKeys TASKS_GET
      Method for polling a task's current state (tasks extension). Returns the Task snapshot without blocking.

    • TASKS_UPDATE

      public static final UniqueKeys TASKS_UPDATE
      Method for delivering input to a task that is waiting for it (tasks extension).

      This replaced the blocking tasks/result method. Its only job is to hand inputResponses to a task sitting in TaskStatus.INPUT_REQUIRED.

    • TASKS_CANCEL

      public static final UniqueKeys TASKS_CANCEL
      Method for explicitly cancelling a task (tasks extension).

    • NOTIFICATIONS_TASKS

      public static final UniqueKeys NOTIFICATIONS_TASKS
      Notification sent when a task transitions to a new status (tasks extension).

      The method name is the bare notifications/tasks, not notifications/tasks/status; the notifications/tasks/ prefix is reserved for future use. The params are the full task snapshot.

    • ROOTS_LIST

      public static final UniqueKeys ROOTS_LIST
      Name of an embedded roots/list request.

      Not a method this server receives. Modern clients discard inbound server-to-client requests, so a server that needs the client's roots embeds this name in an InputRequiredResult instead.

    • SAMPLING_CREATE_MESSAGE

      public static final UniqueKeys SAMPLING_CREATE_MESSAGE
      Name of an embedded sampling/createMessage request. Embedded in an InputRequiredResult rather than sent as a request.

    • ELICITATION_CREATE

      public static final UniqueKeys ELICITATION_CREATE
      Name of an embedded elicitation/create request. Embedded in an InputRequiredResult rather than sent as a request.
